Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 0
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted “the actor from Terminator” as Michael Biehn instead of the far more prominent Terminator actor, Arnold Schwarzenegger. This initial misidentification set the entire workflow on the wrong target (Biehn’s spouses), rather than identifying Maria Shriver as the spouse of Schwarzenegger, leading to the incorrect solution.
